resources.string: Other apps on a rooted phone can read app data. Kasrat-e-Darood keeps your sign-in encrypted, but your account is safer on a phone that isn\'t rooted.
This copy of the app can\'t run
This copy of Kasrat-e-Darood has been modified, or something is interfering with it. For your account\'s safety it has been signed out. Please install the app from Google Play.
